regions.today: Sunshine and showers, some heavy with a chance of hail, and isolated thunderstorms. Moderate, occasionally gusty westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Clear spells and showers tonight, the showers heaviest and most frequent over the western half of the region. Chilly with lowest temperatures of 4 to 8 degrees, and light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday will be bright with sunny spells and scattered showers, which will gradually die out by evening. Cloud will increase from the west through the evening. Highest temperatures of 14 to 16 degrees with moderate westerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate Wednesday. Low to moderate on Thursday.
